nodes.summary: For every divisor $D$ on a set of points $C$ and every point $P \in C$, the coefficient at $P$ of the pole part $D^-$ of $D$ is $\max(-D(P), 0)$.
nodes.title: Coefficients of the pole part

nodes.summary: For every divisor $D$ on a set of points $C$, the pole part $D^-$ of $D$ is effective: $D^-(P) \ge 0$ for every point $P \in C$.
nodes.title: The pole part of a divisor is effective

nodes.summary: For a divisor $D$ on a set of points $C$, the pole part $D^-$ of $D$ is the divisor on $C$ whose coefficient at each point $P \in C$ is $\max(-D(P), 0)$.
nodes.title: Pole part of a divisor

nodes.summary: For every divisor $D$ on a set of points $C$ and every point $P \in C$, the coefficient at $P$ of the zero part $D^+$ of $D$ is $\max(D(P), 0)$.
nodes.title: Coefficients of the zero part

nodes.summary: For every divisor $D$ on a set of points $C$, the zero part $D^+$ of $D$ is effective: $D^+(P) \ge 0$ for every point $P \in C$.
nodes.title: The zero part of a divisor is effective

nodes.summary: For every set of points $C$ and every divisor $D$ on $C$, let $D^+$ be its zero part, with coefficient $\max(D(P), 0)$ at each point $P$, and $D^-$ its pole part, with coefficient $\max(-D(P), 0)$ at each point $P$. Then $D^+ - D^- = D$.
nodes.title: A divisor is its zero part minus its pole part

nodes.summary: For a divisor $D$ on a set of points $C$, the zero part $D^+$ of $D$ is the divisor on $C$ whose coefficient at each point $P \in C$ is $\max(D(P), 0)$.
nodes.title: Zero part of a divisor

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
